Below, text states: ‘Regional New Zealand Health Survey data has now been updated.’ Bottom left shows ‘Te Kāwanatanga o Aotearoa New Zealand Government’, and bottom right displays the Ministry of Health Manatū Hauora logo.

post.text:
We’ve updated the regional New Zealand Health Survey data and added a new video to help people use it with confidence. 

The new explainer video covers:  
- How the regional data is structured.
- How to choose the right statistics. 
- How to interpret the data.

Links in the comments below.
